name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: Path to agent markdown files
        required: false
        default: .continue/agents
        type: string
    secrets:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:
        required: true

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agents: ${{ steps.list.outputs.agents }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: List agent files
        id: list
        run: |
          AGENTS_PATH="${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          echo "Searching for .md agents in $AGENTS_PATH"
          FILES=$(find "$AGENTS_PATH" -type f -name "*.md" -printf '%p\n')
          if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then
            echo "No agent files found."
            echo "agents=[]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            JSON=$(printf '%s\n' $FILES | sed 's/.*/"&"/' | paste -sd, - | sed 's/^/[/;s/$/]/')
            echo "agents=$JSON" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  run-agents:
    needs: discover
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover.outputs.agents) }}
